name: tag
purpose: Use Tag for a read-only category or outcome word on an item (Production, Beta, Allowed) that is not a lifecycle state. The state of a resource is a StatusIndicator, a number is a Badge, a removable or selectable token is a Chip, and a level on the critical → info scale is a SeverityTag. A compact, read-only word on an item, colored by its brand look `variant` or its status colour `severity` so the category or outcome reads at a glance (Production in `variant="primary"`, Blocked in `severity="danger"`). It takes an optional leading icon, a pill shape with `rounded`, and two sizes; it is never interactive and never counts.
useWhen: Label or categorize an item with a short descriptive text, optionally with a leading icon or pill shape.

Show a status with its colour via `severity` (`neutral`, `info`, `success`, `warning`, `danger`), or a category with a brand look via `variant` (`primary`, `accent`, `contrast`, `highlight`); `severity` wins when both are set.
Mark the one value a list highlights (the Owner role in a users table) with `variant="highlight"`: the logo orange as a fill with `--primary-foreground` text, like the success, info and warning tags.
avoidWhen: It is purely a count or one-glance status label → use `badge`.
The user can select or remove it (filters, multi-select values) → use `chip`.
related: `badge` — denser count/short-label indicator with no icon affordance.
bestPractices: Colour comes from `variant` or `severity`; the optional icon is decorative — keep it `aria-hidden`.

Pick the severity by meaning: `success` Active, `warning` Pending, `neutral` Inactive or a neutral category (Developer, Viewer), `info` a second role (Admin), `variant="highlight"` the one value to single out (Owner), `primary` a solid brand label. Do not use `danger` for a state that is only off (Inactive): it reads as an error.
Do not restyle a Tag with colour classes to get a tint; every tint is a `variant` or a `severity`.
Use `rounded` for the pill shape rather than a custom radius.

props.name: label
props.doc: Fallback text when the default slot is empty.

props.name: variant
props.doc: Brand look of the tag surface and label, used when `severity` is not set: `primary` (solid brand orange), `accent`, `highlight` (the brand orange as a tint) and `contrast` (`var(--bg-contrast)` / `var(--text-contrast)`).

props.name: severity
props.doc: Status colour of the tag surface and label, the shared `Severity` scale exported from this component; wins over `variant` when set.

props.name: icon
props.doc: Azion icon class for the leading icon.
